title: Meta introduces Spaces, a new way to collaborate with your Muse agent
summary: Meta's Muse agents continue to get new features and integrations. Spaces promises to be a new way to interact with the AI helpers.
llm_summary: Meta has rolled out “Spaces,” a fresh interface that lets users collaborate with their Muse AI agents in a shared, visual workspace. The new feature adds richer interaction options—like real‑time editing, file sharing, and contextual chat—making Muse assistants more useful for brainstorming, project planning, and everyday productivity. Spaces builds on Muse’s existing capabilities, turning the AI helper from a simple chatbot into a collaborative partner.
